name: NE-CHMIMO
summary: NE-CHMIMO (CHM-018) is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is presumed to be a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug. NE-CHMIMO is the 1-cyclohexylmethyl (instead of 1-pentyl) analogue of the first-generation synthetic cannabinoid JWH-018. The corresponding cyclohexylmethyl derivative of JWH-081 had also been reported several months earlier.

pharmacology.text: NE-CHMIMO (CHM-018) is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is presumed to be a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

uses.text: NE-CHMIMO (CHM-018) is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is presumed to be a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, severe anxiety, paranoia and psychosis, and have been linked to seizures, kidney injury and deaths. They are often far stronger than cannabis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的合成大麻素類藥物，可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、嚴重焦慮、妄想與精神病症狀，並與癲癇發作、腎損傷和死亡有關。這類藥物往往比大麻強得多。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的合成大麻素类药物，可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、严重焦虑、妄想与精神病症状，并与癫痫发作、肾损伤和死亡有关。这类药物往往比大麻强得多。

fact.en: It is a variation on the earlier synthetic cannabinoid JWH-018 in which the straight pentyl tail is swapped for a ring-shaped cyclohexylmethyl group.
fact.zh: 它是早期合成大麻素 JWH-018 的變體，把直鏈的戊基尾端換成了環狀的環己基甲基。
fact.zhHans: 它是早期合成大麻素 JWH-018 的变体，把直链的戊基尾端换成了环状的环己基甲基。
